race.title: John Weight Gone But Not Forgotten Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: CREST OF STARS made a promising start to his chasing career over C&D 11 days ago and expected to build on that, he looks the way to go. Icare Grandchamp 's record fresh is a positive one so he's feared as a previous C&D winner, while Clap of Thunder and Ionian also have something to recommend them. CREST OF STARS (IRE) ICARE GRANDCHAMP (FR) CLAP OF THUNDER (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Crest Of Stars (11/4), Icare Grandchamp (7/2), Ionian (4/1), Clap Of Thunder (9/2), Siam Park (5/1), Reteti (10/1)
